date.as_written: śrī śāke 1758 sāl 1893 māse 8 tithau balācaturdaśī

purpose: maṃtrīpāṭḥārtham: for reading by a (unnamed) minister
notes: The colophon names no scribe, commissioner, owner or king. The copy was made for an unnamed minister to read ('maṃtrīpāṭḥārtham'). The text is a Gorkhali (Nepali) rendering ('gorakṣavālī bhāsā') of the Daśakumāracarita, and this is the end of the 8th ucchvāsa. Two eras are given and they agree: Śaka 1758 and VS ('sāl') 1893 both give CE 1836. The catalogue field 'ŚS 1785' does not match the colophon's 'śāke 1758' and is probably a digit transposition; its 'VS 1893' is correct. 'māse 8' probably means the 8th month counted from Vaiśākha, i.e. Mārgaśīrṣa/Mangsir. That is the month of Bālācaturdaśī (kṛṣṇa 14), which would put the date around late 1836 CE.
